text: Because a concert is more than just the music. You're sharing the moment with thousands of people who love the same thing, and that creates an energy you can't get from headphones. There's also the unpredictability — the band might play a new song or change an arrangement. For many people, it's a way of feeling part of a community for an evening.

tips.kk: More than just the music — жауап аясын кеңейтеді.
tips.ru: More than just the music — ответ расширяет рамку.
tips.example: a concert is more than just the music

tips.en: There's also the unpredictability develops the idea with a new argument.

tips.ru: There's also the unpredictability — развитие мысли новым аргументом.

text: I believe it should, at least to some extent. Without public money, tickets would become so expensive that only wealthy people could attend, and many serious theatres would simply close. Culture isn't just entertainment; it helps a country keep its identity. That said, the money should be spread more fairly, because at the moment most of it goes to the capital.

tips.en: That said … adds criticism to the position.

text: More than you might expect. A few years ago traditional instruments seemed old-fashioned, but now several bands mix them with rock or electronic music, and young people love it. Some of these videos get millions of views online. I think it's partly a question of pride — young people want to show that their culture can be modern and exciting, not just something from a museum.

tips.en: More than you might expect challenges a stereotype right away.
tips.kk: More than you might expect — жауап стереотипті бірден жоққа шығарады.

text: I doubt it will replace them completely. Virtual concerts are great for people who live far away or can't afford to travel, and they might become very common. But part of the magic of a live show is that it can go wrong, and that everyone in the room is physically together. I think the two will exist side by side, like cinemas and streaming services do now.

tips.en: Great for people who live far away is fair to the technology.

text: Partly because touring is genuinely costly — stages, lighting, security and travel for a huge team. But the bigger reason is that musicians now earn very little from streaming, so live shows have become their main income. Resale websites make things even worse by pushing prices far above the original level. I think artists should do more to stop that, since it hurts their real fans.
